propositions: The test walks 884 renderable units serially with ~1768 pandoc spawns, measuring 91.6s idle and 504.8s under CPU saturation, exceeding CI's 300s per-test timeout on the macOS py3.13 cell
pytest-timeout with --timeout-method=thread kills the xdist worker process via os._exit(1) when the budget is exceeded, producing no traceback and crashing the worker rather than failing the test
The single monolithic test loop creates unbounded cost that grows with corpus size and load, causing nondeterministic failures on contended runners
Chunking the equivalence test with fixed-size batches (_EQUIVALENCE_CHUNK=40) bounds per-test cost and distributes work across xdist workers
All 884 units must remain compared against the oracle with real pandoc at stride 1 to preserve the byte-identity property
A coverage guard test must verify that all chunks concatenate to exactly _renderable_units() with total >= 100 to prevent silent unit dropping
